# Saddlehunter

> A community-driven hunting forum and marketplace featuring membership tiers, vendor access, classifieds, and hunting contests.

Saddlehunter operates as a specialized hunting community platform with integrated membership management, vendor policies, and account upgrade systems. The site serves hunters through discussion forums, classified listings, and exclusive member-only features.

## Key Topics

- SH Membership
- SH Members
- Vendor Access Area
- Community Forum
- Membership System
- Account Management
- Account Upgrades
- Hunting Contest
- Classifieds
- Vendor Policies

## Community & Membership

- [Saddlehunter Homepage](http://saddlehunter.com): Main community forum homepage with membership and hunting features
- [Community Forum](https://saddlehunter.com/community/index.php): Central forum hub with vendor access and membership options for hunters
